**废陋巨人城市 The Fomorian Cities**
在那流光溢彩的地表之上，优雅的雅灵城市如王冠上的璀璨宝石般熠熠生辉。而在精类国度的深处，在那超乎想象的广阔地底洞穴中，精类文明的扭曲倒影正闪烁着微光，犹如充满憎恨、向上怒视的邪眼。

其中三处领域乃是废陋巨人的城市：、与。每一座都由一位残暴的巨人统治，他们因驾驭骇人奥术之力而身心俱遭扭曲。作为这些城市的类人臣民，你或是被掳为奴，或是生而为奴；至多，你或许拥有仆役或信使的头衔，尽管这区别纯属名义。漫长的岁月里，你的生活便是在这地底长夜中无休止地劳作，同时时刻担忧会因任何缘由丧命。你曾视为同伴的大多数生灵，都已殒命于黑暗：或被快克灵刺客所杀，或被独眼巨人守卫砸成洞窟地面上不成形的污迹，或是在废陋巨人领主的狞笑中被焚为灰烬。被俘的雅灵、图安人（受精类魔法影响的人类）以及地侏曾与你一同囚禁，但任何同盟都难以持久，因为奴隶们不可避免地会为苟活而彼此背叛。

无论你来自哪一座废陋巨人的城市，在其扭曲暴君的铁拳之下，你所知的唯有苦难与危厄。在，你曾在狭窄的通道中挖掘隧道或寻觅宝石，那里毒气带来无声的死亡，危险的怪物筑有巢穴。在，你被用作消耗性的步兵，投入与蕈人军团和凶残卓尔的血腥冲突。在，你曾是角斗士、宫廷弄臣，或是街头戏耍的对象，几乎不指望能在存活一日。在你城中所有惊恐的囚徒里，唯有那些在废陋巨人统治下被囚禁了漫长得无法记忆的岁月的侏儒，仍能于这惨淡境遇中寻得一丝奇趣。他们的乐观令人想起那句古老的地侏谚语：“黑暗之中，亦有钻石。”

尽管生活悲惨，却鲜有人尝试逃离这些噩梦般的隧道。逃亡的企图会招致残酷的死亡，毙命于恶毒的血侏儒与快克灵的利刃之下。况且，即便有囚犯侥幸逃脱并重获自由，在如此漫长的地底囚禁之后，又能去往何方？大多数饱受折磨的臣民宁愿留在他们熟知危险之中，也不愿逃向未知的险境。

当你遇见另一位废陋巨人囚禁生涯的幸存者时，你们能瞬间认出彼此。这印记并非肉体上的烙痕——废陋巨人视所有生灵为其臣民，觉得费神标记他们毫无意义——而是眼中那熟悉而黯淡的神色，一双曾目睹那不可言说之恐怖的眼睛。你们二人很少交换故事，因为言语无法消弭幸存者的负罪感。你们会默默地将一枚小小的黑色石头埋在对方的石头旁，然后分道扬镳。此习俗源自的一句箴言，意在承认你们共同度过的黑暗岁月，而关于那段岁月，最好缄口不言。

**The Maze of Fathaghn**
有一处地方，林木丛生，彼此紧依，盘曲的荆棘高耸粗壮，犹如活体壁垒。在这里，树木以枝叶窸窣的微语诉说其秘密。林间小径在变幻的树丛与漫游的树人躯干间迷失了方向，嬉闹的仙女与树精将粗心的旅人诱入蜿蜒的歧途，引至幽暗的林间空地，而他们将永远不再出现。

若你来自这座险恶林地迷宫的边缘地带，你几乎必定是一位精类生物，因为其他类人生物鲜能在此长久生存。尽管看似瑰丽富饶，其作为要塞的性质却丝毫不逊于、或是。此地的树人、树精、仙女、侏儒、皮克精及其他精类住民或许显得异想天开或人畜无害，但它们每一个都致力于守护迷宫中心的秘密——据说，树精女王法萨甘在那里守护着那棵赋予第一个绿野妖精生命的母亲之树。作为迷宫中的精类居民，你平日与自然和谐共处，嬉戏度日。然而必要时，你会吓退入侵者，或将他们诱至迷宫深处而亡。传说警示，若有闯入者摧毁了母亲之树，则你们的生命亦将随之终结——或者更糟，将失去所有魔法，变得如凡界一般寻常。

在中，你曾享有庇护与安宁，四面八方都被世间最强大的自然力量所环绕。你为何要离开？是为了从源头遏制潜入者吗？是凡人将你从迷宫中掳走，迫使你在别处效劳吗？抑或是你奉法萨甘女王之命出使，被选为她身在迷宫之外的活代表？无论原因为何，你都将家园深藏于心。

尽管有些生物在面对路径选择时会感到无所适从，但丰富的选项却赋予你一种熟悉的安心感。例如，在林间歧路交错的十字路口，你鲜少犹豫不决。相反，你会缓缓转身三次，以清晰地感知每个方向的境况。随后择一路而行，并向其他路轻声送去祝福。你几乎不解“迷途”为何意，因为于你而言，条条大路皆通某处，而身为的精类原住民，你深信不疑：假以时日，无论目的地何在，你终将寻得其所在，并引以为慰。

**The Murkendraw**
若说是从下方侵蚀之美的毒瘤，那么便是这瑰丽容颜上的一颗脓疮。这片阴郁、濡湿的土地，遍布着各种色调的棕、灰与黑，在时而蕴含毒性的浓重沼泽雾气下溃烂发炎。板结的泥块会突然陷落为流沙，或是显露出杀手藤与黄色麝香蔓形成的帘幕。在无星的夜空中，唯有月亮俯视着下方，将其清冷的光辉投洒在这片单调的荒芜之地。

是一片浩瀚如海的沼泽，其中滋生着精沼巨鳄，其体型堪比漂浮于腐臭碎屑间的平底小舟。肥硕嗜血的沼蝇——有些大如犬类——在傍晚的空气中嗡嗡作响。雷暴会一连数日笼罩此地，以闪电撕裂沼泽，而鬼婆们，例如恶名昭彰的，便在这无拘的混沌中欢欣鼓舞。

若你来自，便早已习惯了在这不宜生存的环境中生活。在此地生存需极度谨慎；一步踏错便可能招致灭顶之灾。然而，对于那些熟知沼泽凶险之人，它亦可成为坚实的盟友。被狂热牧师驱逐出文明世界的女巫们，学会了利用的自然环境来对抗猎巫者，后者的尸骸则滋养了鳄鱼、沼蝇与流沙坑。

沼泽的原住民学会了成为谨慎、耐心的谋划者。的鬼婆有句谚语：“盲目出手者，必遭身后袭。”在这里，鲁莽冲动的行为只会招致死亡。

的居民会在其屋舍的每一扇门与每一扇窗下埋藏一柄寒铁匕首。据说此举可阻止鬼婆及其他邪恶精类入内。

**黯根黑市：**在广袤的边缘那浸水的土壤之下某处，隐藏着一个避开了夏日廷会权贵们怒火的秘密。此地唯有曾亲临者方可知晓，因而得以在那些意图摧毁、征服或榨取它的人的触及之外——至少，在曾有缘至此者背叛它之前是如此。黯根黑市是中一处进行非法与违禁交易的地下集市，一个仙宫贵族们不愿让其治下子民知晓的黑市。

奴隶贩子、毒药商、药效不明的灵药调配师、雇佣兵中介、奇异物品发明家——皆汇聚于黯根黑市兜售其货品。当一位雅灵在舞会上饮酒窒息，或在森林中被吹箭擦伤后倒下，在黯根购入的毒药或许难辞其咎。当一位公主对贫民一见倾心，或宝库中的无价珠宝不翼而飞，黯根的药水常常备受指摘。那令英雄伤残的诅咒，其源头或许在黯根，而其解药亦然。

**地精王国 Nachtur, the Goblin Kingdom**
在雅灵诸领域与地精王国之间的陆路通道上，横亘着一片广袤的荒野。在雅灵领土以南，这片广阔的土地绿意盎然，森林茂密。随着旅者向东向北行进，森林逐渐让位于开阔的草甸，最终变为干燥的岩石地带，继而成为遍布裂隙、沟壑、高耸悬崖与阴沉丘陵的灰色恶地。这片荒原便是通往——被称为的地精国王之国度——的门户。

当地精在其巨人、食人魔与巨魔同伙的簇拥下，从其疆域中汹涌而出时，他们肆意掠夺，滥杀无辜。在你所居住的这片暮色边境之地，有传言称，地精会掳走精类生物与孩童，将他们拖回的宫殿，在那里，无辜者被吞食，而心怀恶念者则被转变为地精。或许你便是从自然界被掳走，后从地精手中逃脱或被救出，却自此一直被困在。

唯有被放逐者、女巫与离群索居之人栖身于这片恶地，而若你自愿在此安家，则须步步为营。那些被自身社会驱逐之人，流落至外围肮脏的边境小镇，无处可去。对雅灵而言，此等判决往往形同死刑；地精数量众多，且对雅灵的仇恨尤为炽烈。一些被流放的雅灵与地精达成交易，充当其线人与间谍；另一些则向地精与城中雅灵两头贩卖情报，以期获得一方的宽恕或另一方的接纳。那些收集满一百个地精头颅的流放者或亡命徒，或可获此宽恕，并被征募入军队或某支专门的冒险者团队。

若你栖身于，须得提防的不仅是地精、巨人、巨魔与食人魔，还有在夜色中潜行的吓人精。这些小精类在遭遇对抗时颇为怯懦。吓人精能在遥远空间之间制造孔洞，从远处伸手窃取你的财物，或是在你睡梦中将你扼杀。地精视吓人精为珍宠，并在训练它们成为刺客方面颇有成效。

在边境流传的童话，鲜少以英雄击败邪恶食人魔作结。相反，它们皆是警世寓言——关于愚人涉足地精事务或试图智胜巨魔，并最终遭遇惨烈下场的真实（或据称真实）记述。外人或许会认为你的故事血腥或病态，但在的土地上，生活本就如此。

title: 大地领域 Earth Domain
body:
关联神祇：摩拉丁 Moradin，托罗格 Torog

The lords of the earth preach patience, endurance, and fortitude in the face of overwhelming odds. Your duty is to be like the rock of the earth to your allies and community, a reliable source of support and strength. While others crumble in despair, you stand tall, strong, and resolute. In so doing, you bring out the best in your allies.

Your body and soul gain the core characteristics of earth: resolution, endurance, and persistence. By focusing your efforts, you enable your allies and yourself to fight through pain.

**1级：大地领域特性和威能 Earth Domain Features and Powers**

The earth abides. It survives the slings and arrows of its enemies. It watches patiently as the days and years follow one after another. When angered, the earth erupts in destructive earthquakes to rend and tear the land. When placated it is quiet, almost invisible in its ubiquity.

Like the earth, your magic endures. With the blessings of the earth, you and your allies can resist attacks with ease. When you strike, you land heavy blows that leave your enemies reeling.

**增益：**你和离你5格内的每个盟友在对抗持续伤害的豁免骰上获得+2威能加值。

另外，当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，在你下一回合结束前，目标从下一次命中他的攻击中只受到一半伤害

你同时获得下列威能

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

This simple prayer is your first step to shaping the magic of earth and stone. At your command, an ally gains the endurance of stone. In imparting this gift, your arms become as hard as granite, lending extra power to your attacks.

⟦大地坚韧 Earth's Endurance⟧

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

This prayer channels divine energy into your weapon. When it strikes a foe, your enemy's limbs become as heavy as granite. Unable to defend itself for a key moment, your foe is left vulnerable to your allies' attacks.

⟦大地重担 Burden of Earth⟧

**领域辅助威能 Domain Utility Power**

The stone is your ally, and with the help of your divine magic you can speak to it to learn its secrets. The stone has few words, but its whispered advice can reveal secrets you otherwise would miss.

⟦岩石交谈 Stone Speak⟧

**领域遭遇威能 Domain Encounter Power**

The earth is an indomitable foe and a potent ally, as demonstrated by this prayer. You unleash the earth's power to transform simple stones into deadly projectiles. In the wake of this attack, the ground shudders and twists, grinding your enemies' advance to a halt.

⟦土质雹子 Earthen Hail⟧

**1级：引导神力（大地领域） Channel Divinity (Earth)**

You channel the strength and resolve of stone into your allies, allowing them to absorb attacks with the stoic resolve of a mountain.

⟦石之刚毅 Stone's Resolve⟧

**3级：大地领域遭遇威能 Earth Domain Encounter Power**

This prayer demonstrates that the earth itself is yours to command. With but a handful of dirt and the power of your magic, you create a warding shield of unbreakable granite. The shield slams into your foes, driving them away before its magic flows back to protect your allies.

⟦岗岩护盾 Granite Shield⟧

**5级：大地领域特性 Earth Domain Features**

Your healing magic flows through the earth and ground. When you mend an ally's wounds, your magic can also pull it across the earth. You draw on the great, implacable weight of the mountains to send your ally into battle or pull him away to safety.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，若目标站在地面上，则你能滑动它等同于你体质调整值的格数

**7级：大地领域遭遇威能 Earth Domain Encounter Power**

Earth's power rests not only in the mountains and crashing boulders but in the subtle power of soil and rock. This prayer lets you draw forth the slumbering power that rests in every shard of earth, even the smallest trace of dust. At your command, they form a mighty weapon that chokes and distracts your enemy as your allies move in for the kill.

⟦尘土之祝 Blessing of Dust⟧

**10级：大地领域特性 Earth Domain Features**

The strength of stone and earth flows through your magic. When you attack, your weapon becomes imbued with the weight and power of an avalanche. Your foes fall before this attack, driven to their knees by your divine might.

**增益：**当你使用对抗强韧的近战神术遭遇攻击威能时，你命中的任何目标同时提供战斗优势，直到你下一回合结束

**11级：虔诚行动（大地领域） Devout Action (Earth)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

The earth beneath you is a living thing. You can feel the ebb and flow of the roots that run through it, the veins of metal hidden within its grasp, and the countless living things that burrow through it. This relationship runs two ways. You feel the earth's pain and joy, and it reflects your emotion. Normally the earth is too vast for your feelings to move it, but in the midst of battle it roars in fury alongside you. When you are pushed to deeds of great valor, the earth trembles beneath your foes in reflection of your wrath.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点获得额外动作时，选择一个离你5格内的敌人。该敌人倒地

**11级：至高祝福（大地领域） Transcendent Blessing (Earth)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

The power of the earth flows through your magic. When you invoke your prayers, they carry the might of earth into your bones. For a brief moment, you have the strength and tenacity of a mountain.

**增益：**当你使用⟦大地坚韧 Earth's Endurance⟧时，其效果对你和一个盟友都生效，而不只是一个人，且你和该盟友同时在强韧上获得+2威能加值

**12级：大地领域辅助威能 Earth Domain Utility Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Stone and earth seem to leap at your command through the power of your divine magic. This prayer allows you to craft a formidable barrier against your enemies in an instant.

⟦石之壁垒 Bulwark of Stone⟧

**13级：大地领域遭遇威能 Earth Domain Encounter Power**

Once you hurled stones imbued with divine energy at your foes. Now, with your superior command of divine magic, you call the earth to rise and fall at your command.

⟦土质先锋 Earthen Vanguard⟧

**16级：大地领域特性 Earth Domain Feature**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Your healing magic not only mends flesh but also grants your allies the strength and endurance of living stone. Attacks made against them are as effective as taking a dagger to a boulder.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，你和爆发范围内除了目标之外的每个盟友获得等同于你体质调整值的全伤害抗力，直到你下一回合结束。若你自己是⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧的目标，则你不获得此增益

**17级：大地领域遭遇威能 Earth Domain Encounter Power**

The earth provides stout, defensive magic, but that is not the limit of its power. This prayer creates a shield of obsidian, a vicious, sharp rock that cuts flesh with ease. The shield slices through your foes before exploding into an aura of sharp spines that protect your allies and harm those foolish enough to stand nearby.

⟦曜岩护盾 Obsidian Shield⟧

**20级：大地领域每日威能 Earth Domain Daily Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

This horrid and deadly attack serves as a final punishment for those who dare stand against your divine power. You bid your enemy's flesh to become one with the stone beneath it, adding its body to the living rock of the earth. Perhaps in its new form, it can atone for the crimes it committed.

⟦埋葬之石 Entombing Stone⟧

**23级：大地领域遭遇威能 Earth Domain Encounter Power**

The earth is many things. From the greatest mountains to a swirling mote of dust on the wind, the earth is the element upon which all other creation rests. With this prayer, you shackle your foe with chains of stone, leaving it defenseless and unable to move.

⟦土质锁链 Earthen Chains⟧

**27级：大地领域遭遇威能 Earth Domain Encounter Power**

During the Dawn War, the gods of earth built a network of mighty citadels to defend the remnants of the divine armies until reinforcements could arrive. Their holding action helped tip the balance in the gods' favor.

⟦土质堡垒 Earthen Fortress⟧
